code_blocks:
Backward Week Planner

Start with Friday outcomes, then map the week backward around focus blocks, energy, and constraints.

Week setupSaved locally

Nothing leaves this browser. Your plan is stored with localStorage.

Friday outcomes

Use hours as the rough work needed before Friday. Higher priority gets placed first.

Focus blocks

These are the available work containers. The planner fills them from Friday backward.

Energy windows

High energy protects deep work. Low energy reduces usable capacity.

Constraints

Hard constraints remove time. Soft constraints cut that overlap in half.

Backward mapReady

Add outcomes and focus blocks, then build the week.

Printed notes

Generated locally from your browser. No external services used.

Done
